Passive: Shatter

Every time you are attacked, reflect physical damage equal to %ability_value_item_0102_damage%%% of armor value. This is S2

Dragon Slash: Sixfold Wind-Fire Slash

Dragon Slash becomes 6 slashes, and units hit repeatedly take 60% damage.

Use: Harden Armor

Increases armor by %potion_bonus_armor% points for %ability_duration% seconds.
Up to 5 potions can be active simultaneously.
Dash up to %dash_distance% distance, gaining high damage reduction during the dash.
Enhances counterattack ability and increases resilience.
